path: HTTP producer -> in-process bounded queue -> one worker -> PostgreSQL
reference_backend: SQLite is for local functional tests only
destination: one study_events table in the isolated study PostgreSQL container
ordering: producer assigns increasing sequence per route; one sender and one worker preserve dispatch order
delivery: up to three HTTP attempts; event IDs are idempotent under primary key (run_id, event_id)
payload: anonymized replay ID, route key, tenant, schema, sequence, emission timestamp
energy_objective: declared system-boundary joules per verified successful event (AC wall or battery DC); compare only within one boundary
hardware_profiles: Lenovo Yoga 7i Gen 9 16-inch: Windows, exact machine type pending, preferred primary target
M1 MacBook Air: macOS 26.6.2, secondary target when checkout is opened there
measurement_limits: Application JSON body bytes and producer CPU are not packets, total network bytes, or whole-host energy
